payload.title: Pilobol.us scaffold does not wire the reader app, so publish never rebuilds it
payload.description: Verified: Ryan published an edit to item articles/the-part-of-the-machine-that-could-talk in the new Pilobol.us CMS (app dv0pdx67fk80m) at about 20:00 EDT 2026-10-06 and no reader rebuild started (reader app dssc97s4q5kgk has no job after job 7 at 19:34). Cause: the backend passes site.reader ({ amplifyAppId, branchName? }) to rebuildTriggerSettings, which sets PAPYRUS_READER_AMPLIFY_APP_ID and PAPYRUS_READER_BRANCH on the content-actions Lambda and grants amplify:StartJob/ListJobs on that app branch jobs. The scaffold papyrus.config.ts backend (AnthusAI/Pilobol.us main) has no reader key, so the live Lambda env has PAPYRUS_CMS_AMPLIFY_APP_ID and PAPYRUS_STAGING_BRANCH but not the reader vars. Fix: add reader: { amplifyAppId: "dssc97s4q5kgk", branchName: "main" } to the backend block of Pilobol.us papyrus.config.ts.
